claims.canonical_content: Home working can help some teams.
claims.raw_span: I think home work can help some teams.

claims.canonical_content: One six-person team completed 48 rather than 40 support tickets during a four-week trial.
claims.raw_span: In our six-person team, completed support tickets rose from 40 to 48 during a four-week trial.

claims.canonical_content: The observation covers only one team and a short period.
claims.raw_span: That is only one team and the period was short.

claims.canonical_content: Run a three-month measured trial of two home-working days before deciding.
claims.raw_span: So I would test two home-working days for three months, measure tickets and errors, and then decide.

relations.rationale: The limited observation supports the deliberately limited thesis.
The text states the limits of the observation.
A limited trial rather than a universal policy follows from the limited evidence.
The recommendation responds to the stated limitation.
